name: Diageo Plainfield Bottling Plant - Plainfield IL

fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE. Street View (2024-07) of the east dock yard shows a sliding gate across the truck driveway with a STOP sign and a numbered gate sign ('GATE 6'), set in a continuous chain-link perimeter fence. The legacy bottling plant runs a secured, fenced dock yard - distinct from the open canning campus next door.
fieldNotes.guardShack: TRUE. A small red-roofed guard booth (~1-vehicle footprint, windows) sits beside the truck lane on the east side of the gate, visible in Street View at 41.6241,-88.2130.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a staffed booth is present, so this is not a remote/kiosk check-in.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: True - the bottling plant is part of the larger connected Diageo Plainfield campus shared with the Lincolnway RTD canning facility and a process tank farm; multiple large building masses on one campus.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Fenced east dock yard holds parked trailers alongside the dock bank.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Long bank of dock doors on the east building face with trailers backed in; ~45 doors estimated (band 25-50), moderate confidence from Street View and overhead.
fieldNotes.dropArea: ~35 trailers visible in the fenced dock yard, capacity ~60 (band 10-25 for tractorless drop trailers specifically; flagged uncertain).
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: At least two numbered gates referenced on signage ('GATE 6'); estimated 2 active truck gates into the fenced yard.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Plainfield IL industrial corridor with adjacent farmland; Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs east of the campus but no spur enters the bottling-plant property.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Gate apron is modest; no obvious unused width for an express bypass lane.
